svg.title: Б.3 — Управление заказом на поставку стандартной продукции

g.text: Б.3 — Управление заказом на поставку стандартной продукции
G1 = (order_number_filled AND product_name_filled AND supplier_name_filled AND quantity_in_range)
G4 = (amount_in_range AND prepayment_le_30 AND NOT block_reason_filled) OR (is_office_order AND amount_in_range AND prepayment_le_50 AND NOT block_reason_filled)
G5 = (order_number_filled AND product_name_filled AND quantity_filled AND amount_filled AND supplier_name_filled AND delivery_days_filled AND prepayment_percent_filled)
G1..G5 — только сокращения для рисунка, не дополнительные предикаты.
